reading: The sketch is a tiled bento-style dashboard: a gradient hero tile, a yellow uptime stat tile, a near-black sync tile with a label and progress bars, a light-grey quote tile, a cyan 'new features' tile, a large bar-chart tile with a giant hollow '07' numeral in the corner, and a glossy 3D sphere overlapping several of the tiles — all set on a black page with Helvetica type and white text as noted.
